triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Regraded p2 → p1** (R1210, 03:5xZ). Third hit: at 03:18Z, #34709's group was ejected again by the same case (Test Core 7/10, "Test timed out in 5000ms"). That makes three ejections in about 7 h: #34752 at 20:50Z, and #34709 at 01:07Z and 03:18Z. #34709 is a governed PR the maintainer enqueued himself.

It is still one root, so there is no jump (#34152). But it is now the fleet's most frequent repeat ejection, so by addendum 7 (it removes the current largest repeat-ejection bottleneck) it is p1. It goes to repo:objectstack#1, the p1 seat. The fix shape in the body stands: a measured timeout, or call the regrade in process.

Closed as a duplicate of **#35110** at 2026-11-18T04:05Z. It is the same case (`skill-evals.test.ts` "--regrade … a reworded case …", 5 s default timeout) and the same signature. #35110 carries the deeper reading (shard co-location with `plugin-security`) and is now the anchor at p1. The three hits listed here (#34752 at 20:50Z, #34709 at 01:07Z and 03:18Z) carry over.
